column1: # Pulumi project-name inventory — the guard against a rename orphaning stack state.
# Pulumi keys STACK STATE on the `name:` inside Pulumi.yaml, not on the directory.
# Renaming that field does not migrate anything: Pulumi treats it as a brand-new
# project, silently leaving the old stack (and the resources it tracked) behind
# while the new one starts EMPTY and tries to create infrastructure that already
# That is not hypothetical. #2061 renamed six projects as part of a naming-convention
# migration; deploys broke for days and it was only found by tracing a red delivery
# lane back through an empty stack. Recovery meant exporting each old stack, rewriting
# the project name embedded in every URN, and re-importing (#2154 has the full trail).
# Pulumi.yaml must have a row here whose name matches exactly. A changed name FAILS
# until the state migration is done and the row updated; a new program FAILS until it
# is added; a row for a program that no longer exists FAILS as stale.
